title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
description: Learn Linux, networking, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and production operations.

tree.name: Linux, Git, and Networking
tree.description: Start with the operating system, version control, HTTP, DNS, SSH, and shell scripting.

children.name: Shell Scripting
children.description: Automate repeatable tasks with Bash, environment variables, pipes, and exit codes.

children.name: Networking Basics
children.description: Understand TCP/IP, ports, DNS, TLS, proxies, firewalls, and request debugging.

tree.name: CI/CD and Release Automation
tree.description: Build pipelines that test, package, scan, and deploy applications consistently.

children.name: Automated Tests in Pipelines
children.description: Run unit, integration, lint, and security checks before code reaches production.

children.name: Build Artifacts and Environments
children.description: Version releases, manage secrets, separate environments, and automate rollback plans.

children.name: Practice: CI/CD Failure Drill
children.description: Break and fix pipeline failures, image builds, environment variables, health checks, and rollback steps.

tree.name: Containers and Orchestration
tree.description: Package apps with Docker, run multi-service systems, and operate workloads on Kubernetes.

children.name: Docker Compose
children.description: Run local service stacks with networks, volumes, health checks, and environment configuration.

children.name: Kubernetes Workloads
children.description: Deploy, expose, scale, update, and debug apps through Kubernetes primitives.

tree.name: Infrastructure as Code and Operations
tree.description: Provision cloud resources, monitor systems, respond to incidents, and improve reliability.

resources.title: Learn Terraform and AWS by Building a Dev Environment (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Monitoring and Logging
children.description: Collect metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards that explain production behavior.

children.name: Incident Response and Runbooks
children.description: Prepare on-call playbooks for outages, failed deploys, high latency, rollback, escalation, and postmortems.

children.name: Project: Deploy a Real App
children.description: Containerize an app, create CI/CD, deploy to cloud, add monitoring, and document runbooks.
